signals.rationale: The listener nods his head affirmatively while the speaker makes their point, demonstrating clear physical assent.
The listener maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering his response, speaking with a clear and steady voice.
The listener maintains focused eye contact with the speaker and tilts his head slightly, showing active attention to the conversation.

The man exhibits physical signs of tension, including a nervous smile, quick blinking, and swallowing. He also looks down and away while fidgeting with his hands, indicating an effort to manage his anxiety.
